game.title: Raja-Chor-Mantri-Sipahi (King-Thief-Minister-Soldier)
game.description: A role-playing game where four players randomly draw roles of Raja (King), Mantri (Minister), Chor (Thief), and Sipahi (Soldier). The Minister must correctly identify the Thief based on clues.
game.occasion: Indoor gatherings, rainy days, school breaks
howToPlay: Step 1: Write 'Raja', 'Mantri', 'Chor', and 'Sipahi' on separate slips of paper.
Step 2: Four players each pick a slip without showing others.
Step 3: The player who gets 'Raja' reveals their identity and sits as the King.
Step 4: The 'Mantri' (Minister) must guess which of the remaining two players is the 'Chor' (Thief).
Step 5: The 'Sipahi' (Soldier) and 'Chor' maintain neutral expressions.
Step 6: The Mantri asks questions or observes behavior to deduce the Chor.
Step 7: Raja awards points: Mantri gets 500 points if correct; if wrong, Chor gets the Mantri's 500 points.
Step 8: Raja gets 1000 points automatically, Sipahi gets 100 points.
Step 9: Roles are shuffled and the game repeats for multiple rounds.
Step 10: The player with the highest total points after predetermined rounds wins.
